title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go - parity & version bump v1.198.2
author: Samira Gupta
description: Motivation: multiple SDKs had slightly divergent auth retry behavior and streaming ergonomics which caused parity bugs in multi-language client deployments and flaky fallbacks. This PR unifies auth/retries logic into a shared policy across Python/TypeScript/Go, improves streaming backpressure and reconnect semantics, and applies ergonomics fixes requested by SDK users. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce a language-appropriate RetryPolicy abstraction (Python: RetryPolicy class with backoff and jitter; TypeScript: RetryPolicy interface + default implementation; Go: retry.Policy struct) and centralize auth token refresh+retry to avoid double-retry on 401 during streaming reconnect. 2) Streaming: stabilize client-side backpressure by making stream iterators cooperative - Python async iterator yields incremental chunks while honoring Cancel/timeout, TS adds AsyncIterable and stream.on('data') callback patterns, Go exposes Context-aware StreamReader with Close/Abort. 3) Parity fixes: surface server request_id in responses across SDKs, ensure consistent error types (AuthenticationError, RetryableError), normalize metadata fields. 4) Tests & CI: add cross-SDK integration tests that exercise token refresh path, streaming reconnect, and a small e2e that validates request_id presence. 5) Docs & changelogs: update quickstarts and migration notes. Checklist: - [x] unify retry policy implementations - [x] streaming ergonomics improvements in all SDKs - [x] add unit + integration tests - [x] update docs & changelogs - [x] version bumps (python/ts/go) Compatibility notes: All changes are backwards-compatible for typical use; Go had a tiny API ergonomic change (StreamReader.Close returns error) documented in migration notes. Release: bumps Python->v1.198.2, TypeScript->v1.198.2, Go->v1.198.2. See release_notes for user-facing highlights.

release_notes: v1.198.2: SDKs: unified auth/retry policy across Python/TypeScript/Go; improved streaming ergonomics (async iterable / callbacks in TS, async iterator in Python, Context-aware stream reader in Go); request_id now surfaced consistently in responses; bug fixes for streaming reconnect and token refresh race conditions; no notable breaking changes except documented StreamReader.Close behavior in Go.
notes_for_backport: Backport to release/1.197.x only if customers running older pinned versions experience token-refresh streaming disconnects. Includes test additions that may need adjustments for older CI images.
